# Yango Vendor Projects

This directory stores runnable OpenHarmony ESP32 projects owned by the Yango vendor namespace.

Each project lives in its own folder:

- `gpio_blink/`
- `uart_echo/`
- `i2c_scan/`
- `spi_loop/`
- `wifi_sta/`
- `tcp_http/`

Use `make menuconfig` and select `Project To Run` to choose the active project.
